name: Pipeliners - Low-Hanging Fruit Keyword Tutorial 2026-09-19
body:
> Guide · Pipeliners · 2026-09-19

# Summary
A 7-page picture tutorial (PDF and HTML) showing how to find keywords Google already shows Pipeliners for and move them from page 2 or 3 to page 1 without guessing. Uses real Pipeliners GSC data from Aug 19 to Sep 15, 2026.

# Key points
- Position bands: 1 to 7 is the top of page 1 (protect it), 8 to 30 is the low-hanging fruit zone, 31+ needs bigger work.
- Six steps: 1 confirm it is real, 2 match the right page, 3 put the keyword where Google reads first, 4 add what is missing, 5 link to it, 6 tell Google, then wait.
- "Real" means seen 3+ times on 2+ days, average position 8 to 30, and one page clearly owning it. Example pass: "cipp pipe lining cost" (22 impressions on 8 days). Example fail: "main line clog phoenix" (6 of 7 impressions on one day).
- If two pages split a keyword, pick one and give the other a different job; do not create a new page for the same keyword.
- Match intent: cost searches need a cost answer (no prices), local searches need city detail, how-to searches need an explanation, near-me searches need a service page with a call to action.
- Stop if the only ranking page is the homepage or a Google Ads page.
- House rules repeated: no prices or unverified claims, "Pipeliners" not "Pipeliners USA", no em dashes, never touch the homepage, phone numbers or Google Ads pages.
